topic: How the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent harness is built, from first principles
goal: Understand every part of DeepSeek Harness from its source code and build mini-dsh, your own harness with the same architecture: a plugin kernel, an event-sourced session log, a DeepSeek model adapter, a guarded tool pipeline, a sandbox, compaction, MCP and code-mode tools, subagents, an SDK surface and replay tests.
pace: about three months; from absolute basics to advanced, 90 lessons
